angle: Two host friends. One asks how the other copes with three flats; the answer is that Hububb took the admin, not the listing.

thread.text: ok how are you running three flats now, you look weirdly relaxed
Hububb. the turnovers get booked, the pricing moves on its own, and guest messages get answered in my voice
and airbnb is fine with that?
still my listing. still my reviews. i just stopped doing the admin
right, sending you my address, come do mine
